entities.entity_tagline: Learning Never Ends! Never Goes in Vain.

obsessed_people: Students who want to continuously learn
Students who believe learning never stops

brand_strategy.purpose: To build a culture of lifelong learning among students.
brand_strategy.transformation_promise: Students become consistent learners who continuously improve through practice and repetition.
brand_strategy.perception: A learning-first platform that believes practice and consistency shape a person's future.
brand_strategy.exclusive_positioning: The only choice for students who believe mastery comes through disciplined practice and continuous learning.

obsessed_people: Students who value conceptual understanding over rote learning

purpose: To teach students how to study
To make students fall in love with studying
To create lifelong learners who continuously evolve in the AI era
transformation_promise: A genuine love for learning and studying
brand_strategy.perception: A teacher who makes students excited and emotionally connected to the process of studying.
exclusive_positioning: The only choice for students who want conceptual depth instead of surface-level learning
Best suited for students who strongly believe in self-learning

obsessed_people: People who want to understand how technology works internally
People who enjoy customizing and experimenting with technology
Tech lovers interested in App Development, Automation, and AI

purpose: To simplify technology so even an 11-year-old can understand it
To make technology approachable and user-friendly
To help people understand not just how to use technology, but how it works internally

core_analogy.description: Just like car enthusiasts learn engines, gears, pistons, and customization, technology learners should understand code, frontend, operating systems, versioning, servers, automation, and AI.

transformation_promise: People gain clarity about the building blocks of technology
People become capable of customizing and eventually building their own tech solutions
brand_strategy.perception: Someone who makes App Development, Automation, and AI concepts so simple that even an 11-year-old can understand them.
brand_strategy.exclusive_positioning: The only choice for tech lovers who want to deeply understand and build technology instead of merely using it.
